screenshots.title: Secure Operator Authentication
screenshots.alt: Border-AI secure login screen with clean dark theme and MFA-ready form
screenshots.description: Clean login interface utilizing Argon2id authentication and secure session cookies without exposing default credentials.

screenshots.title: Live Operator Command Center
screenshots.alt: 2x2 live video surveillance grid showing real-time YOLOv8 bounding boxes and camera status indicators
screenshots.description: Real-time 2x2 multi-camera MJPEG video grid with active spatial zones, ByteTrack persistent IDs, and telemetry counters.

screenshots.title: Critical Alert Toast Notification
screenshots.alt: Pulsing red critical alert toast displaying vehicle plate, threat score 80, and acknowledge button
screenshots.description: Sub-50ms WebSocket alert toast triggered upon vehicle watchlist detection with instant audio chime and triage actions.

screenshots.title: Explainable Threat Factor Breakdown Drawer
screenshots.alt: Slide-out inspection drawer showing pre-annotation evidence JPEG and factor score contribution checklist
screenshots.description: Forensic evidence drawer displaying the pre-annotation evidence snapshot and mathematical threat factor breakdown.

screenshots.title: Scenario 1 Perimeter Intrusion Alert Card
screenshots.alt: Alert card displaying Score 60 High priority breach with zone and line crossing factors checked
screenshots.description: Plan Scenario 1: Restricted zone entry (+30), virtual tripwire (+20), and after-hours movement (+10) summing to Score 60 (HIGH).

screenshots.title: Forensic Search Workbench & Facets
screenshots.alt: Forensic search table with plate look-alike badges, date pickers, and virtual keyset pagination
screenshots.description: Historical sighting search featuring OCR look-alike phonetic matching (Levenshtein substitution costs) and faceted filters.

screenshots.title: Cross-Camera Vehicle Journey Reconstruction
screenshots.alt: Visual topological journey graph tracing vehicle progress across cameras with transit times
screenshots.description: Reconstructed vehicle timeline across CAM-01 -> CAM-02 -> CAM-04 with speed plausibility validation and anomaly detection.

screenshots.title: Transactional Email Notification (Mailpit)
screenshots.alt: HTML email notification showing threat details, embedded evidence snapshot, and deep link to incident
screenshots.description: Transactional outbox email dispatch delivering formatted incident alerts with inline snapshots and secure deep links.

screenshots.title: System Operational Status & Telemetry
screenshots.alt: System health dashboard indicating component statuses for Postgres, Redis, AI Engine, and RTSP streams
screenshots.description: Comprehensive system telemetry monitor reporting camera heartbeats, streaming queue depths, and uptime.

screenshots.title: Cryptographically Verified Audit Log
screenshots.alt: Administrative audit trail displaying user actions, resource IDs, and SHA-256 hash chains
screenshots.description: Immutable operational audit log featuring cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining to guarantee audit trail integrity.
